place.name: Malecón Simón Bolívar
place.description: Malecón Simón Bolívar (also known as the Malecón 2000) is the name given to the boardwalk overlooking the Guayas River in the Ecuadorian port city of Guayaquil. An urban renewal project focusing on the old Simón Bolívar boardwalk, it stands along the west shore of the river for an approximate length of 2.5 km.
